CalculatorPage.title: Study Cost Calculator

Calculator.visaNoteFree: Citizens of your country can enter visa-free but pay for the residence permit in Germany (~110€).
Calculator.scholarshipCheckbox: I have a public scholarship/stipend (Erasmus, DAAD, etc.) - Visa fee exempt
Calculator.minijobInfo: Current limit for 2025 is approx. 556€/month. Usually tax-free and minimal social contributions.
Calculator.werkstudentInfo: Max. 20 hours/week during the semester. You pay into pension insurance but are exempt from other social contributions.
Calculator.dayRule140: Non-EU students are allowed to work 140 full days or 280 half days per year (new 2025 regulation).
Calculator.hoursWarning: Working more than 20h/week during the semester may affect your student status and insurance.
Calculator.selfEmploymentWarning: IMPORTANT: Self-employment (Freelancing/Business Registration) is generally NOT allowed for international students unless explicitly approved by the Foreigners' Registration Office.
Calculator.disclaimer: Note: All calculated costs are estimates for guidance only. Visa fees, insurance premiums, and living costs are subject to change. No liability is assumed for the accuracy of this data. Status: December 2025.

Calculator.universityAutoPopulated: City, rent, and semester fee have been auto-populated based on your selection.
Calculator.privateUniversityNote: This is a private university. Please enter the tuition fee per semester.

Calculator.selectUniversityFirst: Please select a university first to enable PDF export
Calculator.housingTypeDormInfo: Dorm places are limited and often have waiting lists. Apply early through the Student Services Office (Studentenwerk).
Calculator.housingTypeWGInfo: Shared apartments are popular among students. Search on shared apartment platforms or similar services.
Calculator.housingTypePrivateInfo: Private apartments offer more privacy but are significantly more expensive. Usually requires higher income proof.
Calculator.housingRentOverrideNote: You can manually adjust the rent if you have a specific offer or estimate.

Calculator.rundfunkbeitragInfo: Mandatory fee for every household in Germany. Billed quarterly (55.08€ every 3 months). The cost is usually shared among all residents.
Calculator.securityDepositNote: Typically 3 months' rent (refundable when you move out)
Calculator.initialHouseholdSetupAmount: Estimated average for basic household setup (Furniture/Kitchenware)
Calculator.arrivalCostsNote: Note: This excludes flight costs and is separate from visa/blocked account fees.
Calculator.languageCourseQuestion: Do you need a preparatory German language course?
Calculator.languageCourseCostNote: Estimated average: 550€ per month for intensive German courses
Calculator.findLanguageCourses: Find certified language schools & intensive courses here
Calculator.targetCityLabel: Where do you want to study?

Calculator.smallGap: ⚠ Small gap - consider additional funding (parents, scholarships, blocked account)

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.introductionText: The following information provides a simple overview of what happens to your personal data when you visit this website. Personal data is any data with which you can be personally identified.
Privacy.responsibleText: The party responsible for processing data on this website is:
Privacy.legalBasisText: The processing of personal data is based on Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation). Our legitimate interest is to improve our website and analyze user behavior to optimize our services.
Privacy.serverLogsText: The hosting provider (Vercel) automatically collects and stores information in so-called server log files, which your browser automatically transmits to us. These are:
Privacy.serverLogsItems: IP address, Date and time of the request, Time zone difference to Greenwich Mean Time (GMT), Content of the request (specific page), Access status/HTTP status code, Amount of data transferred, Website from which the request came, Browser type and version, Operating system and its interface, Language and version of the browser software
Privacy.serverLogsPurpose: This data is collected for technical reasons to ensure the stability and security of the website. The data is stored for a maximum of 7 days and then automatically deleted. The legal basis for this processing is Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR.
Privacy.ga4Text: This website uses Google Analytics 4, a web analytics service provided by Google Ireland Limited ("Google").
Privacy.ga4Anonymization: IP Anonymization: We have activated IP anonymization on this website. This means that your IP address will be shortened by Google within member states of the European Union or in other contracting states of the Agreement on the European Economic Area before transmission to the USA. Only in exceptional cases will the full IP address be transmitted to a Google server in the USA and shortened there.
Privacy.ga4Purpose: Google Analytics uses cookies to analyze your use of the website. The information generated by the cookie about your use of this website is usually transmitted to a Google server in the USA and stored there. The legal basis for this is Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR.
Privacy.ga4Prevention: You can prevent the collection of data generated by the cookie and related to your use of the website (including your IP address) by Google and the processing of this data by Google by downloading and installing the browser add-on available at the following link:
Privacy.ga4OptOut: Browser Add-on to disable Google Analytics
Privacy.cookiesEssential: Essential Cookies: This website uses essential cookies that are necessary for the website to function properly. These cookies cannot be disabled.
Privacy.cookiesAnalytics: Analytics Cookies: This website uses Google Analytics cookies to analyze user behavior. These cookies are only set with your consent (via the cookie banner).
Privacy.cookiesStorage: Cookie Storage: Cookie preferences are stored locally in your browser using localStorage. This data is not transmitted to our servers.
Privacy.rightsInformation: Right to Information (Art. 15 GDPR): You have the right to obtain information about the personal data we process concerning you.
Privacy.rightsCorrection: Right to Correction (Art. 16 GDPR): You have the right to request the correction of inaccurate or incomplete personal data.
Privacy.rightsErasure: Right to Erasure (Art. 17 GDPR): You have the right to request the deletion of your personal data, provided that the legal requirements are met.
Privacy.rightsRestriction: Right to Restriction of Processing (Art. 18 GDPR): You have the right to request the restriction of the processing of your personal data.
Privacy.rightsObjection: Right to Objection (Art. 21 GDPR): You have the right to object to the processing of your personal data based on Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR.
Privacy.rightsComplaint: Right to Complain to a Supervisory Authority (Art. 77 GDPR): You have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority, in particular in the Member State of your habitual residence, place of work, or place of the alleged infringement.
Privacy.contactText: If you have any questions about data protection or wish to exercise your rights, please contact us:

Timeline.title: Road to Germany Timeline
Timeline.subtitle: Your personalized journey to studying in Germany. Click on each step to learn more.
Timeline.semesterStartNote: Adjust this date to see when you should complete each step.
Timeline.universityDesc: Start your application process through uni-assist or directly to your chosen university. Prepare all required documents (transcripts, language certificates, motivation letter). Deadlines vary by university and program.
Timeline.admissionDesc: Once you receive your admission letter, immediately start the blocked account process (Fintiba, Expatrio, or Coracle). You'll need the Confirmation of Financial Resources (06 Confirmation) for your visa application.
Timeline.visaAppointmentDesc: Book your visa appointment at the German consulate in your country. You need this for your visa application. We recommend TK (public) or a private 'Incoming' insurance for language students.
Timeline.visaApplicationDesc: Submit your complete visa application with all required documents: admission letter, blocked account confirmation, health insurance certificate, passport, and visa fee payment receipt.
Timeline.accommodationDesc: Start searching for accommodation early! Use Student Services Office, shared apartment platforms, or university housing services. Book your flight once you have your visa approved. Housing in major cities (Munich, Berlin, Hamburg) is extremely competitive.
Timeline.arrivalDesc: Arrive in Germany, register at the local registration office (Residents' Registration Office), open a bank account, and complete your university enrollment. Don't forget to apply for your residence permit at the Foreigners' Registration Office within 90 days.
Timeline.timelineDisclaimer: Important Note: This timeline is for guidance only and is non-binding. Deadlines for visa applications, university admissions, and insurance can change depending on your country of origin and institution. Always verify official deadlines with the relevant authorities. Status: December 2025.
